en: Hello, my name is Amy.
What is your name?
Nice to meet you.
I live in a small town.
I work at a bookstore.
Are you new here?
Please speak a little more slowly.
Could you say that again?
I do not understand this word.
How do you spell your name?
My sister lives near the station.
There are four people in my family.
My brother is making breakfast.
Our parents are coming tomorrow.
Is this your grandmother?
The children are playing outside.
I usually call my mother on Sunday.
zh: 我通常在星期日打電話給媽媽。

en: Who takes care of the baby?
We eat dinner together every evening.
zh: 我們每天晚上一起吃晚餐。

en: This is a photo of my family.
Please leave your shoes by the door.
The keys are on the kitchen counter.
Could you open the window?
I need a clean towel.
zh: 我需要一條乾淨的毛巾。

en: There is a lamp beside the bed.
Please turn off the television.
The washing machine is in the bathroom.
We keep the milk in the refrigerator.
zh: 我們把牛奶放在冰箱裡。

en: The room is too dark to read in.
zh: 這個房間太暗，沒辦法看書。

en: I cannot find the remote.
I would like a glass of water.
May I see the menu, please?
Does this soup contain milk?
I am allergic to peanuts.
Could we have two spoons?
zh: 可以給我們兩支湯匙嗎？

en: The bread is still warm.
Please put the rice in this bowl.
I would like my coffee without sugar.
Could we have the bill, please?
Can I take the rest home?
zh: 剩下的可以讓我打包帶走嗎？

en: How much does this shirt cost?
Do you have this in a smaller size?
zh: 這個有小一點的尺寸嗎？

en: May I try these shoes on?
I am just looking, thank you.
Where can I find a shopping basket?
zh: 我在哪裡可以拿到購物籃？

en: These tomatoes look fresh.
zh: 這些番茄看起來很新鮮。

en: Can I pay by card?
Could I have a receipt?
I bought the wrong size.
Is it possible to return this item?
Where is the check-in counter?
Here is my passport.
I have one suitcase to check.
zh: 我有一件行李箱要托運。

en: Is this the line for security?
Which gate should I go to?
zh: 我應該去哪一個登機門？

en: My flight has been delayed.
I am visiting for a week.
I will stay at a hotel near the airport.
zh: 我會住在機場附近的飯店。

en: I have nothing to declare.
zh: 我沒有需要申報的物品。

en: My suitcase did not arrive.
Does this bus go to the station?
Where can I buy a train ticket?
zh: 我在哪裡可以買火車票？

en: How often does the bus come?
Please let me know when we arrive.
Is this seat taken?
I missed the last train.
zh: 我錯過了最後一班火車。

en: Could you take me to this address?
zh: 可以載我到這個地址嗎？

en: Please stop at the next corner.
You need to wear a helmet.
The traffic is heavy this morning.
zh: 今天早上的交通很壅塞。

en: I have a reservation for two nights.
zh: 我訂了兩個晚上的住宿。

en: Could I check in now?
zh: 我現在可以辦理入住嗎？

en: What time is breakfast served?
Does the room have a private bathroom?
Could I have an extra pillow?
zh: 可以再給我一個枕頭嗎？

en: The air conditioner is not working.
There is no hot water in the shower.
Could someone clean the room?
What time do we need to check out?
May I leave my bags here for a few hours?
zh: 我可以把行李寄放在這裡幾個小時嗎？

en: I need to charge my laptop.
zh: 我需要替筆記型電腦充電。

en: The keyboard is not connected.
Could you send me the file?
zh: 你可以把檔案寄給我嗎？

en: Let us discuss this after lunch.
zh: 我們午餐後再討論這件事。

en: When is the next meeting?
zh: 下一場會議是什麼時候？

en: I wrote the details in my notebook.
zh: 我把細節寫在筆記本裡。

en: Could I borrow your pen?
Please reply by Friday.
I have finished the first part.
Could you explain the problem again?
zh: 你可以再解釋一次問題嗎？

en: What does this sentence mean?
How do you pronounce this word?
Please listen before you answer.
Can you give me an example?
I made a spelling mistake.
Let us practice one more time.
Please write your answer here.
I remember the sound but not the spelling.
zh: 我記得發音，但不記得拼法。

en: This question is easier than the last one.
I can understand more than before.
zh: 我比以前能聽懂更多了。

en: I do not feel well today.
I have a sore throat.
How long have you had this cough?
I need to see a doctor.
Where is the nearest pharmacy?
How often should I take this medicine?
zh: 這個藥應該多久吃一次？

en: Should I take it with food?
zh: 這個藥需要隨餐服用嗎？

en: I am allergic to this medicine.
Could you call an ambulance?
Please wash your hands with soap.
It looks like rain this afternoon.
zh: 今天下午看起來會下雨。

en: Do not forget your umbrella.
It is much colder outside.
The sun is coming out.
It is too windy to fly a kite.
The weather is nice enough for a walk.
There may be a storm tonight.
The ground is still wet.
Remember to drink water when it is hot.
The rain stopped a few minutes ago.
What do you like to do on weekends?
I enjoy taking photos.
Would you like to go for a walk?
There is a park near my house.
I am learning to play the guitar.
Do you want to watch a movie tonight?
I usually read before bed.
We are going swimming tomorrow.
Could you take a picture of us?
Let us meet at the entrance.
Excuse me, where is the restroom?
zh: 不好意思，洗手間在哪裡？

en: Go straight and turn left.
The bank is across from the station.
Is it within walking distance?
You can cross at the next crosswalk.
zh: 你可以在下一個行人穿越道過馬路。

en: The elevator is beside the stairs.
I think we are going the wrong way.
Could you show me on the map?
zh: 你可以在地圖上指給我看嗎？

en: The shop is between the bank and the cafe.
zh: 那家店在銀行和咖啡廳之間。

en: How long does it take to get there?
My phone is almost out of battery.
Do you have a charger I can borrow?
zh: 你有充電器可以借我嗎？

en: Could you turn down the volume?
zh: 你可以把音量調小一點嗎？

en: I cannot hear you clearly.
The screen is too bright.
Please connect to the wireless network.
I forgot my password.
The message did not go through.
Try closing the app and opening it again.
zh: 試著關閉應用程式後再重新開啟。

en: Could you send me the photo?
zh: 你可以把照片傳給我嗎？

en: What are you doing this weekend?
zh: 你這個週末打算做什麼？

en: I am going to visit a friend.
Let us leave a little earlier.
We need to book the tickets in advance.
I will call you when I arrive.
Can we change the time?
I am free after three.
Something came up at work.
Could we meet another day?
Please let me know if your plans change.
zh: 如果你的計畫有變，請告訴我。

en: I am a little nervous.
You look tired today.
I am glad you are here.
Do you need some help?
It is okay to make mistakes.
I feel better after a short break.
zh: 短暫休息後，我覺得好多了。

en: Thank you for being patient.
That sounds exciting.
I am sorry I kept you waiting.
I am proud of what I have learned.
zh: 我為自己學會的東西感到驕傲。

en: I think there is a mistake on the bill.
zh: 我覺得帳單上有一處錯誤。

en: This is not what I ordered.
Could you help me find my bag?
I left my wallet on the bus.
zh: 我把錢包忘在公車上了。

en: My room key does not work.
Could I speak to the manager?
I need to cancel my reservation.
Is there another way to solve this?
zh: 有其他方法可以解決這個問題嗎？

en: Thank you for helping me sort this out.
zh: 謝謝你幫我處理好這件事。

en: Everything is working now.
